transcript: Last night, masquerade was turned into a late night club as a part of their new Carnival of shadows, which is a late night adult variety and clown show. Now this is their first time doing something like this so I really had no clue what to expect, but it was actually so much fun. It is essentially a variety show with six different acts with a roaming server serving drinks before the show and during intermission. They also had lazer, who some of you may recognize from masquerade itself. He was one of the original carneys in the carnival scene, but his job last night was just to keep us entertained before the show started with games and free drinks to the winners. The show itself was hosted by actor Matthew Curiano, who is also currently in masquerade as one of the managers. But that is where the masquerade crossover stops. All of the acts were completely new and ranged anywhere from puppetry to burlesque to extreme hula hooping. Many of the acts were definitely not safe for work and I certainly can't show you on here, including one woman who was basically completely naked and sprayed herself with bioluminescent hairspray, which is maybe one of the wildest things I've ever seen. Out of all of the late night entertainment options that masquerade has offered, this one might just be my favorite. It was their first time doing a show in the Lair space, so there's definitely some kinks to work out, including some sightline issues for people on the side, but otherwise it feels like such a natural extension of the vibe that they've curated over there. It definitely shares some DNA With the carnival scene in the show itself, but this version feels far less sinister, And now with 100% less child abuse. And considering the carnival is one of my favorite sequences of the show, this new performance offering could not be more up my alley and I hope they do more.
